propositions: A new generator script must read config schema, deprecation registry, and secret-name inventory to produce authoritative config-reference and security documentation that stays synchronized with the underlying registries.
The generator must produce fully-generated docs that include registry-derived tables and curated narrative sections, with top-of-file banners naming the generator command.
The existing docs/config.md must remain byte-unchanged with all its consumers (content-asserting tests, anchor deep links) continuing to work.
A drift detection gate using --check mode must fail when generated docs become stale, supporting CRLF newline normalization to prevent false failures on different checkouts.
Both new generated docs must be registered in the test marker registry and docs/README.md table, and navigation links must be added to docs/README.md and docs/architecture.md.

Required topics (precedence, source, lifecycle, refresh, observability, subprocess limits, behavior deltas, exposure) must have anchors across the generated docs, verified by explicit topic-coverage tests.
